I came here because I was experiencing quite severe foot pain — likely plantar fasciitis combined with posterior tibial tendon strain. For a few days, I could barely walk properly and even simple movement was uncomfortable.

After the treatment, I was honestly quite surprised — I could walk much more normally right away, with significantly less pain.

The practitioner was experienced and knew exactly where the problem areas were. The treatment itself was focused and effective.

Of course, I understand this type of condition also requires proper rest and follow-up care, but this session definitely gave me immediate relief and helped me get back on my feet.

If you’re dealing with foot pain, especially from overuse or sports, this place is worth trying.

Saw Kon Narat and he gave me a whole body adjustment (similar to chiropractic) that made me feel immediately better. He’s a master practitioner with over 20 years experience.  As always, make sure you let him know of any preexisting conditions.  Definitely recommend.

For the first time in many years, I can honestly say that I feel a real and meaningful difference. I notice clear improvement in my posture, my sitting, and especially in my mobility.

NARAT is a true professional who deeply understands the body and clearly knows exactly what he is doing. From the very first session, I felt I was in the best hands possible.

I wholeheartedly recommend him to anyone dealing with chronic or complex physical issues. This work made a genuine difference for me, and I am deeply grateful!

Narat and his assistant are amazing.

I went there to see Narat two days in a row as I had pretty severe back and hip pain making it hard to walk. I messaged him through LINE to see if he would take me right when he opened. He took time to explain a few things and to understand my concerns. As I was in so much pain, I booked an appointment right when he opened at 9am. When I went to see him he took the time to understand my concerns and understand my body. He pointed out a lot of different issues and how he would try to fix it. Unfortunately he said it wasn’t a quick fix which is why I had to go twice.

On the first day he was able to do a small adjustment which gave me a lot of relief, but it still was painful. His assistant gave me a massage down my back with care for my spine as he said that it was very tight and they don’t move well at all. He did a small back adjustment and a neck adjustment that I really needed to loosen up the tension and tightness. So on the first day it felt better but was still sore.

On the second day I went back my hips and back were looser but still felt tight and painful. When I went to see him his assistant did a good massage of the back to loosen it up a bit, then he said he would try a new technique to loosen up the spine. He went to town on my spine and it felt great. After, he did a small adjustment to my neck, which hurt because of how tight it is. He was able to relieve the pain by doing some scraping and a certain pen technique which was really amazing.

After, he said that my posture looks very hunched over, so he recommended cupping. I’ve had cupping before, but it has never been so incredibly effective. It really pulled out those sore muscles and gave it space. Once he finished the cupping, almost all my hip and back pain disappeared. He also cupped my neck and shoulders in a way I’ve never had before which made it feel a lot looser.

I wish I could stay one more day to see what he’d do tomorrow, but I can say that he knows what he’s doing and really goes that extra mile to ensure he tries to get to the root of the problem. I’ve gone to many chiropractors in Canada over the years and none were this effective. He did not do a 5 minute crack and make you leave.

His pricing is very reasonable too.

900 Baht first day
900 Baht for chiropractic treatment second day
500 Baht for cupping on the second day.
Overall 2,300 Baht.

This is not money wasted and was very well spent.

When I left the store a group of 5 adults walked in after me. I think that sets the tone for how good he is as well.

I highly recommend Narat. Thank you for your help.

This is NOT a place which will treat a specific injury, it is a place where you will have your joins and spine cracked, similar to what you can usually from most massage places as a part of a one-hour Thai massage.

It will feel good, but the way these things work is that a day later you can have the exact procedure, and it will crack the same way again and again.

If you have a slipped disk in the spine or something else which causes specific discomfort, the spasm of the muscles needs to be taken care of and relaxed first via massage, acupuncture, or several other means before attempting to send it back to the proper place via chiropractic manipulation if one is wants to have long-lasting effect. Yes, customers will feel a reduction of pain days later, but that's the way the back works, 90% of most injuries tend to heal themselves once the inflammation gets reduced with time and the help of anti-inflammatory medicine (you can google this information)

The 10-15 minute procedure done here has no actual medical value, only the placebo effect. Try the osteopathy treatments in Chiang Mai if you experience discomfort with your muscles/joints which actually require intervention for improvement.
